title: AMD Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
text:
SANTA CLARA, Calif., Aug.  04, 2026  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- AMD (NASDAQ:AMD) today announced financial results for the second quarter of 2026. Second quarter revenue was $11.5 billion, gross margin was 54%, operating income was $2.0 billion, net income was $2.3 billion and diluted earnings per share was $1.38. On a non-GAAP
